our_interpretation: The sentence offers a qualified inference from naming and development history.

The naming history and development difficulties can be checked separately, but establishing them would not settle the qualified inference as written.
criteria.support_condition: No unique support condition can be specified for the whole sentence without selecting an unstated meaning of hit a wall and strengthening suggests into a firm causal claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No unique contradiction condition follows from the wording. Subsequent improvement could coexist with a temporary obstacle and would not refute a qualified contemporary inference.
